verdict.rationale: The only admin-control evidence is thin: work/school notification setup is gated 'if allowed by your administrator' (docs-3), and a user reports their company restricts sign-in to Authenticator push (comm-9). App Lock appears only as a user-enabled setting (docs-6, docs-17), and password export is a user action (docs-10), with nothing showing an admin can enforce or restrict either. Missing for 10: admin-enforced App Lock, admin restriction of export/backup, mandated strong master credentials, centralized org-wide app policy management documentation.
